summary: Fourteen days in Sydney after a long flight from Zurich: jet-lag day, harbour, beaches, Blue Mountains, Manly, local neighborhoods, and a buffer day — paced for long-haul, not a city break.

days.title: Arrival in Sydney and a light intro
days.travelHack: After ~22 hours of travel: get an Opal card at the airport + train to Circular Quay — taxi is significantly pricier.
days.transportationTips: Airport Link to the city ~15–20 min. A hotel near Quay/The Rocks makes the first evening easier.
days.localWarnings: Don't plan big excursions — jet lag is real.

afternoon.name: Arrival at SYD and train to the city
afternoon.description: Land, collect luggage, and transfer to the hotel.
bullets: Today is only check-in and rest.

afternoon.name: Check-in and rest
afternoon.description: Settle in and freshen up after the long flight.
bullets: Quick shower and 1–2 hours of rest.
Evening is just a light walk.

evening.name: Short walk through The Rocks
evening.description: Light harbour intro — no long program.
bullets: Photo of the Opera House from afar, if you're up for it.
Don't plan a transfer back to the airport — you're already in the city.

evening.name: Light dinner in The Rocks
bullets: Pub meal or seafood — one table.

days.title: Jet-lag recovery — harbour at your body's pace
days.travelHack: After Europe→Australia, day 2 is reserved for slowness — don't fill it with Blue Mountains.
days.transportationTips: Everything on foot or a short ferry; Opal card.
days.localWarnings: If you sleep until 10:00, that's fine — don't push it.

morning.name: Slow morning and coffee by the water
morning.description: Adjusting to the time zone without a schedule.
bullets: Coffee in The Rocks or Barangaroo.

afternoon.name: Barangaroo Reserve and Waterfront
afternoon.description: Calm afternoon walk along the harbour.
bullets: Optional ferry to Milsons Point and back.

evening.name: Early dinner in Barangaroo
evening.description: One light dinner — early to bed.

days.title: Opera House, Harbour Bridge and Royal Botanic Garden
days.travelHack: Book the Opera House tour online; BridgeClimb is expensive — Bridge Pylon Lookout is enough for most.
days.transportationTips: Everything is walkable from Circular Quay.
days.localWarnings: Sunscreen — UV is strong even in October.

morning.name: Sydney Opera House — guided tour or exterior + steps
morning.description: Morning visit to the icon when the light is best.
bullets: 1-hour tour or walk around the building.
Then Botanic Garden toward Mrs Macquaries Point.

afternoon.name: Royal Botanic Garden and Mrs Macquaries Chair
afternoon.description: Classic views of the Opera House + Bridge.
bullets: Picnic or snack in the garden.

days.title: Bondi to Coogee coastal walk
days.travelHack: Start in Bondi early; the walk to Coogee takes ~2–3 hours with stops.
days.transportationTips: Bus 333 to Bondi; bus back from Coogee.
days.localWarnings: Swim only between the red-and-yellow flags.

morning.name: Bondi Beach — coffee and start of the coastal walk

afternoon.name: Bondi → Coogee coastal walk
afternoon.description: The best walking day in Sydney.
bullets: Lunch in Coogee at the end of the walk.

evening.name: Dinner in Coogee or back in the city
bullets: Don't add a second evening block.

days.title: Beach rest — Bondi or Bronte
days.travelHack: After the coastal walk, treat yourself to a schedule-free day — long-haul travel needs breathing room.
days.transportationTips: Bus to Bondi/Bronte; walk between beaches.
days.localWarnings: UV index is high — hat and sunscreen.

morning.name: Morning swim or coffee at Bronte
bullets: Bronte baths if the sea is calm.

afternoon.name: Beach rest or short walk to Tamarama
bullets: Optional ice cream on Campbell Parade.

days.title: Blue Mountains day trip
days.travelHack: Train from Central to Katoomba (~2h). Scenic World is optional — Echo Point is essential.
days.transportationTips: Opal works on the train. Head back before dark.

morning.name: Train to the Blue Mountains (Katoomba)
bullets: Plan on a full day out of the city.

morning.name: Echo Point — Three Sisters
bullets: Photos in the morning — less fog.

afternoon.name: Scenic World or Prince Henry Cliff Walk (shorter section)
afternoon.description: One concrete afternoon block — not both in full.
bullets: Choose railway/skyway OR a 60–90 min cliff walk.
Train back to Sydney late afternoon.

evening.name: Light dinner after returning to Sydney
evening.description: One dinner — tiring day, no second block.
bullets: Near the hotel; early to bed.

days.title: Manly ferry and North Shore
days.travelHack: Ferry Circular Quay → Manly is part of the experience — don't swap it for the bus.
days.transportationTips: Opal on the ferry. Manly → Shelly Beach walk.

morning.name: Ferry to Manly
bullets: Sit outside if it's not windy.
On Manly, Corso to the beach first.

morning.name: Manly Beach and Shelly Beach walk

afternoon.name: Return and Barangaroo / Walsh Bay
afternoon.description: Calmer afternoon walk by the water.

days.title: Free / local day — Surry Hills and Paddington
days.travelHack: Intentionally different from harbour/beach days — no Opera House repeat.
days.transportationTips: Bus or short walk from the CBD.

morning.name: Surry Hills — coffee and walk along Crown St
morning.description: Local pace, not a tourist checklist.

afternoon.name: Paddington Markets (weekend) or Oxford St + Centennial Park

days.title: Taronga Zoo or Art Gallery + Hyde Park
days.travelHack: Taronga: ferry + gondola/bus. If you're not into zoos — Art Gallery of NSW + The Domain.

morning.name: Taronga Zoo (or Art Gallery of NSW)
morning.description: One main morning visit — not both.
bullets: Taronga: koalas + views of the Opera House.
Alternative: Art Gallery of NSW for 2–3 hours.

afternoon.name: The Domain / Hyde Park walk
afternoon.description: Easy afternoon wrap-up in the city.
bullets: Optional shopping at Pitt Street Mall.

evening.name: Dinner in the CBD / Darlinghurst
bullets: Pick a neighborhood near the hotel.

days.title: Watsons Bay, South Head and ferry
days.travelHack: Ferry to Watsons Bay + walk to The Gap / South Head — a classic with less crowding than Bondi.
days.transportationTips: Ferry from Circular Quay; Opal valid.
days.localWarnings: Cliffs at The Gap — stay behind the railings.

morning.name: Ferry to Watsons Bay
morning.description: Morning ride across the eastern harbour.
bullets: Sit on the right for Opera House views.
Coffee by the beach at Watsons Bay first.

morning.name: South Head and The Gap walk
bullets: Hornby Lighthouse, if access is open.
Picnic or fish & chips on the beach.

afternoon.name: Camp Cove and ferry back
afternoon.description: Quieter beach before returning to the city.

evening.name: Dinner in Potts Point or Kings Cross
evening.description: One dinner after the ferry day.

days.title: Newtown, Glebe and local culture
days.travelHack: King Street = street art, bookshops, vegan/Asian food — a different Sydney from the harbour postcard.
days.transportationTips: Train or bus to Newtown; walk toward Glebe.

morning.name: Newtown — King Street walk
morning.description: Local street with murals and cafés.
bullets: Street art between King and Enmore Rd.

afternoon.name: Glebe Markets (weekend) or Glebe Point Rd
afternoon.description: Afternoon in the neighborhood — one focus.

days.title: Royal National Park or Palm Beach (optional excursion)
days.travelHack: Pick ONE full-day trip: Royal National Park (train + walk) OR Palm Beach / Northern Beaches (bus).
days.transportationTips: RNP: train to Waterfall/Cronulla + local transfer. Palm Beach: bus L90.
days.localWarnings: In the park: water, hat, charged phone — limited signal.

morning.name: Departure for nature day trip
morning.description: Early start — one concrete destination for the whole day.
bullets: Royal National Park: coastal walk section.
Or Palm Beach + ferry to Ettalong (if weather allows).

afternoon.name: Hike / beach and return
afternoon.description: Afternoon focus in nature, then back to the city.
bullets: Don't combine both trips in one day.

days.title: Buffer / shopping / last proper dinner
days.travelHack: Last full day before departure — leave room for rain, delays, or a favorite spot you missed.
days.transportationTips: Walk / ferry as you like; no new long day trip.

morning.name: Last harbour walk or museum of your choice
bullets: Or Australian Museum / MCA — pick one.

days.title: Last morning and departure
days.travelHack: For an afternoon international flight, leave the hotel 4 hours before departure.

morning.name: Last coffee at Circular Quay
morning.description: Easy wrap-up — no new full-day program.

afternoon.name: Transfer to SYD and international departure
afternoon.description: Train/taxi to the airport and check-in.
bullets: Arrive 3 hours before an international flight.
No phantom 'arrival' — this is departure day.
